decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core dosimetry and particle-therapy QA strategy, and a 2019 release after the initial US limitation is consistent with a specialized medical device rollout rather than a reason to exit.
A small-volume ionization chamber strengthens the firm's precision measurement portfolio for modern radiation therapy and supports cross-selling with its calibration, software, and QA services.
Even if similar to another chamber, keeping it is sensible because clinical dosimetry customers often need distinct chamber geometries or use cases within one validated vendor ecosystem.
A standard clinical ionization chamber is a core, recurring product for routine radiotherapy QA and anchors the broader measurement and support offering.
Relative dosimetry is central to safe beam commissioning and verification, so this product directly matches the firm's value proposition around reliable workflows and compliance.
A thimble ionization chamber is a mainstream clinical workhorse that complements the rest of the chamber range and helps the firm offer a complete end-to-end QA portfolio.
